title: Derivative of the affine moment
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $r,c\in\mathbb R$, and let $X:\Omega\to\mathbb R$. Define $M(t)$ as the average over $x\in\Omega$ of $(1+ctX(x))^r$, and define $D(t)$ as the average of $rcX(x)(1+ctX(x))^{r-1}$. At any $t\in\mathbb R$ for which $1+ctX(x)>0$ for every $x\in\Omega$, the function $M$ is differentiable at $t$ with derivative $D(t)$.
